body:
Could we allow defining developers define their own error keys?
So `validate` could return a string (or even array of strings) being error keys:
```
 validate={(value) =>
    value === 'password' ? ['literal-password'] : null
  }
```

And `Field.Message` would reference it:
```
<Field.Message show="literal-password" />
```
